shared: Eggs hidden in enemy units hatch into chicks when a fight clock strikes, and dormice sleep until then.
differ: Where power comes from: repeating chime combos, the enemy's own stats, or tuning the clock's speed.

takes.label: The chiming combo flood
takes.line: Chimes stack and repeat: Ottilie re-runs every Start of Combat on each strike, Red-Mouth makes three chicks per egg; fights flood late.
takes.look_if: huge in-fight combo moments where every clock strike sets off more.

takes.label: Feed on their size
takes.line: Chicks take a quarter of their host's stats, so it preys on the enemy's biggest units; Gernegroß returns with their stats.
takes.look_if: a tribe that punishes tall boards by feeding on their size.

takes.label: Tune the clock
takes.line: Chicks hatch inside the enemy's line and fight there; you set the clock's speed for eggs, sleepers or hour effects.
takes.look_if: to tune timing and positioning, with chicks fighting from the enemy's side.
